title: [3.0.0.1-dev-b] Ok-Cancel in black in Time or Date Picker Dialog
symptom: In the Time or Date Picker Dialog, the Ok-Cancel buttons appear in black, making them hard to see. The user does not know how to change the style of these dialogs.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit referenced in the thread, with credits to a user who suggested a solution. The fix likely involved changing the style of the date picker dialog, but the exact change is not described in the thread.
